severity.description: Severity is an implementation-defined classification such as "sev1" or "page".

condition.description: Condition defines the burn-rate comparison used to determine whether this alert condition is breaching.

AlertConditionSpec.description: AlertConditionSpec defines an alert's severity and burn-rate condition.

kind.description:
Kind selects the condition calculation.
OpenSLO defaults Kind to [AlertConditionKindBurnRate].
This SDK does not apply that default.

op.description: Operator compares the calculated burn rate with Threshold.

threshold.description: Threshold sets the numeric burn-rate boundary.

lookbackWindow.description: LookbackWindow sets the period for burn-rate calculation.

alertAfter.description:
AlertAfter sets how long the burn-rate comparison must remain true before the condition becomes breaching.
An [AlertPolicy] controls whether that state triggers an alert.
OpenSLO treats an omitted value as "0m".
This SDK leaves it unset.

AlertConditionType.description: AlertConditionType defines a comparison against an SLO's burn rate.

Annotations.description: Annotations maps metadata keys to implementation- or system-specific values.

DurationShorthand.description: A shorthand representation of time duration, e.g. '1m', '10d', '2w'.

Label.description: A label value that can be either a single string or an array of strings.

Labels.description: Labels maps each metadata key to a set of values.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the object's human-readable name.

labels.description: Labels contains metadata associated with the object.

annotations.description: Annotations contains implementation- or system-specific metadata.

Metadata.description: Metadata identifies and describes an OpenSLO v1 object.

description: AlertCondition defines a burn-rate condition for an SLO.
